completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.procedure: Action; range 150 feet; V/S/F. KEEP an area appearing as another terrain. NEW choose a perceived supported terrain center within 150 feet and line of effect; the stationary horizontal footprint has radius up to seventy-five feet, so its maximum horizontal span is the printed 150 feet. Its visual depiction occupies at most thirty feet above or below the chosen center, clipped by real barriers and the terrain actually perceived when composed. Replace Instantaneous with concentration up to one hour. At casting specify one static visual terrain appearance based on actual known/perceived shapes: stone can appear grassy, safe ground can look broken, or visible shallow water can look like a dry bed. It does not reveal or accurately reconstruct concealed geography. NEW only background terrain appearance changes: creatures, independently carried objects, buildings, vehicles, doors, mechanisms and actual light sources remain visibly themselves; it cannot paint a concealing opaque surface over them. It may disguise a perceived natural pit or apparent footing, but the illusion provides no real floor. It does not remove actual visual obstruction: a real boulder painted as grass still blocks sight/line of effect and physically obstructs passage. A false boulder on empty ground adds no mechanical blocked sight, cover or collision. No sound, smell, temperature, touch, harvest, difficult-terrain modifier, navigation success or forced movement is created. Observers can make the shared examination or witness conclusive contradiction; an informed observer can distinguish the false appearance without seeing through real obstacles. The image is fixed to its initial world area and never follows a vehicle or relocates with uprooted terrain. Newly exposed ground or arriving objects are not newly mapped or given an intelligently adapted image; actual departures/changed objects can supply evidence of the false overlay. There is no independent image control after casting. Overlapping such depictions retain separate records; NEW at a shared visual surface only the latest successful depiction is presented, with an older still-active one becoming apparent if the later one ends. Knowing one does not automatically identify an independently different illusion. Suppression removes only the affected source appearance while its clock runs; concentration loss, expiry or removal ends it.
completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.newChoices: NEW 150-foot maximum span distinct from 150-foot casting range, thirty-foot vertical bound, one-hour concentration and terrain-only static image. Explicitly no body masking, false mechanical opacity or new physical terrain; latest depiction handles overlapping appearances without deleting sources.
workedCases: IN4-02-A: A perceived natural ten-foot pit lies inside the chosen footprint. It is painted as ordinary ground, but a pole passes through the false surface and reveals that contradiction to its observer. Stepping there still invokes the real fall; successful Investigation creates neither support nor a safe route.

IN4-02-B: The center is 150 feet away and the chosen radius is 75 feet, giving a 150-foot span rather than a 150-foot radius. A wagon entering the area remains visible. A real stone wall remains a physical and sight barrier even if its surface has been painted with a grass-like appearance.
completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.originalQuestion: Preserve an area appearing as something else up to150ft, Core Action/range150ft/Instantaneous. Resolve whether150ft bounds range, extent or both, then finite three-dimensional geometry, anchored location and lifetime/concentration. Define visual versus other senses, interaction/disbelief procedure, creature/object masking, affected observers and current illusion-information protections. Actual support, routes, obstacles, cover and hazards do not become new physical terrain merely from appearance. Decide movement of underlying terrain, entry/exit, suppression and overlap without free buildings, harvestable materials, sound/smell/touch or unbounded hostile concealment.

completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.procedure:
KEEP both source placements, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and concentration up to one minute. NEW choose one willing creature, including yourself, perceived within 60 feet and line of effect. The casting range selects that recipient; a separate NEW 60-foot sensory extent moves with its actual body. Combine both preserved placements' explicit benefits into this single identity: darkness, all illusions, invisibility, shapechanges and transmutations. This proposed union does not grant an unacquired school or class mode. There is no save for a willing recipient, and the benefit requires no continuing range tether to the caster.

Within the extent and actual unobstructed sensory path, the recipient sees normally through ordinary or magical darkness, sees actually Invisible creatures/objects, and perceives sensory illusions as identifiable false overlays. Darkness removal is observer-specific and casts no light for others. It does not penetrate actual opaque barriers, physical smoke/fog or opaque mundane material. Blinded or missing usable sight still prevents sight; darkness alone is bypassed, not the Blinded condition. Normal hearing or another genuinely functioning sense can identify an illusory sound/tactile impression whose actual apparent source lies within the extent and accessible sensory path, without gaining hearing while Deafened or receiving messages through walls. An existing remote sensor does not acquire this effect or move its extent; its own express sharing rules must supply any separate permission.

NEW the recipient sees the underlying original appearance beneath an actually operative shapechange/transmutation, including an ongoing permanent form spell. The body remains in its current mechanical form with its actual HP, anatomy, equipment and permissions. This reveals appearance only, not a name, history, alignment, motives, creature statistics, identity documents or lost earlier transformations. A completed instantaneous conversion that now leaves ordinary matter supplies no ongoing false form to pierce. Seeing an original silhouette does not find hidden objects inside the body or restore missing matter. Physical concealment/Hidden still needs ordinary detection; an invisible creature is not automatically found through cover. Once genuinely seen, its Invisible-specific unseen modifiers are bypassed for this observer within the benefit's scope.

For current visual illusions, this is conclusive personal identification without an examination Action. Identification removes only perception-dependent deception and any consequence whose own source explicitly ends on disbelief. It does not dispel the source for other observers or cancel an independently specified psychic packet, fear relation or compulsion. NEW explicit bridge to the unadopted Mental Prison proposal: a recipient seeing through its own subjective prison leaves that illusion mentally; the prison's one still-live ordinary exit packet resolves under its own rule, rather than treating True Seeing as antimagic. Greater Phantasmal Killer's independent damage proposal and Spectral Army's explicit detonation remain capable of damage. These cross-proposal choices await joint review. Concentration ending, expiry, actual removal or recipient death ends this sight. Suppression suspends it while the clock continues. Separate True Seeing sources add no range and retain independent endings; renewed paid casts grant no new knowledge beyond present actual perception.
workedCases: IN6-01-A: A willing ally 45 feet away receives True Seeing. It can see an actually exposed Invisible foe 50 feet from its own body in magical darkness; the caster's later distance is irrelevant. A second foe behind a stone wall is not revealed. The recipient gains neither a new targeting line through that wall nor the foe's name or alignment, and ordinary companions receive no shared sight.

IN6-01-B: A creature in an operative transformed body is seen as both its current form and its underlying original appearance. Its current mechanical form and HP remain. Seeing through an ongoing private Mental Prison is the proposed mental departure and can trigger that prison's one live exit packet; it does not suppress that payload. An instantaneous rock-to-mud result does not reveal a complete geological history.
completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.newChoices: NEW willing recipient plus 60-foot sensory extent, explicit union of both placements, source-bounded nonvisual identification, underlying-appearance limit and precise cross-proposal disbelief/damage interfaces.
completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.originalQuestion: Preserve BOTH placements: Divination sees through ALL illusions, invisibility and SHAPECHANGES; Illusion sees through DARKNESS, illusions and TRANSMUTATIONS. Both Core entries give Action/60ft/concentration up to1minute. Resolve whether60ft is recipient casting range, sensory extent or both, who receives the sight, actual sight/line of effect and three-dimensional geometry. Preserve the additional darkness and transmutation wording explicitly rather than silently selecting one school. Define the perceived information about a transformed body versus its actual mechanical form, ongoing hidden objects and nonvisual illusions. Seeing through does not itself dispel a spell, restore the original body, grant true names/alignment/history or penetrate physical opaque barriers. Reconcile exact disbelief/illusion and invisibility modifiers, concealment, suppression, blind observers, remote sensors and actual form changes. No unrestricted cosmic knowledge or planar sight is implied.
